statement: Bootstrap evidence identifies multiple plausible <=NT$500 solo-meal candidates beyond 醇一, including ZAC ZAG, 穆記牛肉麵, 孫麵店, 鼎泰豐, 春水堂（中正店）, Bebu 春嬌粄條, 來一片義式小餐館, 阿財牛肉湯, 小喬新疆羊肉串 and 蘇杭點心店; several remain on freshness/policy watch until first-party dine-in charges are fully closed.
